subject.title: feat: bound reads from open file descriptors

question: Should fs-safe permanently expose bounded reads from caller-owned descriptors and handles, together with additive standalone JSON `maxBytes` options, as supported public API?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but these exports establish an externally consumable API contract beyond the internal race-hardening change.

options.title: Accept the advanced API
options.body: Merge the documented descriptor and handle helpers as the supported composition primitive after real behavior proof is added.

options.title: Keep the hardening internal
options.body: Retain the bounded implementation for existing capped readers but remove the new public exports and JSON option surface if that contract is not intended.

recommendation.title: Accept the advanced API
recommendation.body: Merge the documented descriptor and handle helpers as the supported composition primitive after real behavior proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence links this person to the proposed public API and affected implementation, though current-main ownership could not be verified.
